title: IFSC Input
description: Prevents bank transfers to the wrong branch by catching the letter O typed for the IFSC's fixed zero, a missing 0, digits in the bank code and guessed prefixes like AXIS for UTIB, then reading the branch back from a pluggable lookup (Razorpay IFSC API shape) and warning when it belongs to a different bank than the one picked.
stops: Transfer sent to the wrong branch
